newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Basic sees 1996 net at 7.58 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Basic sees 1996 net at 7.58 mln pesos.

text.p: Philippine oil explorer Basic Petroleum & Minerals Inc said on Friday it expects to post 7.58 million pesos in net income for 1996, rising to 64.8 million pesos in 1997.
Basic said in a disclosure to the Philippine Stock Exchange that it will generate 25.14 million pesos in revenues this year and 83.8 million pesos in 1997.

Increased revenues in 1997 will come from the company's stake in non-oil exploration ventures such as the polypropylene plant of Petrochemicals Corp of Asia Pacific (Petrocorp) which will be on stream next year, it said.
Basic has a 7.15 percent stake in Petrocorp.
Basic said its record date for its pre-emptive rights offer has been set on November 8. Basic offered one share for every two shares held last May.
Basic reported net profit of 4.92 million pesos in calendar 1995 and a first quarter 1996 net loss of 1.35 million pesos.
